title: Safety and ethical considerations in AI use
body:
Using AI responsibly means staying aware of a few recurring risk areas:

  • Bias — models learn from human-generated data, which contains human biases. Review sensitive content critically.
  • Misinformation — hallucinated facts can spread if not verified before being shared.
  • Privacy — be cautious about pasting sensitive personal, medical, or financial data into AI tools whose data policies you haven't checked.
  • Attribution and originality — AI-generated content can closely resemble copyrighted material; understand licensing terms, especially for commercial work.
  • Overreliance — leaning on AI for judgment calls it isn't equipped to make (medical, legal, financial decisions) without appropriate human review.
